messages:
nina: Hey folks — running into a flaky user-reported PII in logs for /api/v1/ingest. Need short-lived admin to fetch a few recent pod logs and run a grep. Not planning to export a full dataset, just 2h of logs. Any objections?

samir: What's the exact commands you need and why admin vs read-only?

nina: Need access to kubectl exec & logs in prod namespace to do `kubectl logs -n prod svc-ingest-*/ -c ingest --since=2h | grep -iP '\b(email|ssn|credit)\b'` — sometimes the mask/filter doesn't trigger on malformed payloads. Read-only cluster role doesn't let me run the container-side grep.

security-bot: Policy reminder: temporary elevation for debug requires ticket ID, business justification, duration (<=4h), and data handling plan. All elevated sessions are audited and flagged. See /policies/privileged-access.

olivia: @nina can you confirm no export/distribution of raw logs? If you find PII we need to follow the redaction playbook (mask in place, open incident if >1 user affected).

nina: Confirm — no export. If PII present I'll redact in-place and paste sanitized excerpts only. Ticket: INF-8042 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8042). Justification: investigate ingestion path that may bypass request-scrubber for malformed payloads. Duration requested: 2 hours.

security-bot: Received. Tagging: elev_request=INF-8042, requested_by=nina, ttl=2h. Automated check: user no outstanding compliance flags.

oncall-sre: I can grant a break-glass window for 2h starting now. Will scope kube role to `prod/namespace:svc-ingest-*` and only allow `logs, exec` for that period. I will attach `audit_tag: 1787654321-DBG` to all actions.

samir: Please include the exact rolebinding YAML in the thread so ops audit can verify. Also prefer `kubectl logs --since` and `grep` inside a debug container rather than `kubectl exec` into prod containers where possible.

oncall-sre: rolebinding YAML (applied):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: temp-debug-nina-inf8042
  namespace: prod
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: temp-debug-logs-exec
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: nina
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

oncall-sre: Role grants `pods/log` and `pods/exec` for label selector `app=svc-ingest` only. TTL=2h. Audit tag attached.

olivia: Security note — before you grep, toggle redaction preview so any matches are flagged. Console path: Console -> Audit -> Redaction -> Preview mode. Make sure `redact_candidate=true` is set for your session.

nina: Got it. Starting now. Will post sanitized findings in this thread. If I find >10 user records with unmasked PII I will file an incident immediately. :shield:

oncall-sre: Session started and logged. If anyone needs to revoke earlier, ping me.

nina: Done. Found two malformed events with raw email fields. Redacted copies attached below (sanitized):
```
{"id":"xxxx","email":"redacted@example.com","payload":"..."}
```
No SSNs or CC numbers. Closing request after 30m. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
